4875-5412-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5412-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-4659-6671-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1558-3257-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3257-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

751-1362-3314-3470.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1976-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

5223-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5223-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5223-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1267-4034-5147.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4034-5147.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

1267-2921-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2921-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7509.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1170-2642-4050-7522.description:
Cast a copy of Stream of Life by paying {G}.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2074-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2074-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vorapede.
Vorapede dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vorapede, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

1965-2034-5224-7183.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

11-2196-7089.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{U}.
11-2196-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Frantic Search spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Frantic Search spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Frantic Search and returning the original Frantic Search to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search from step 9, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Holding priority, repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1115-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

323-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

877-6844-6986.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying {0}.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-1883-2743.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Replication Technique twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Replication Technique spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
1318-1883-2743.notes: You can choose to use Replication Technique's demonstrate ability instead. This would only require Echo Mage to be level 2 or higher.

183-1878-2634-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
183-1878-2634-5195.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
183-1878-2634-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

1323-4762-6260.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4762-6260.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

1617-4831-4890-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Dack's Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4890-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Dack's Duplicate to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

618-1734-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-1671-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-4677.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5147-5191.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have a way to give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
5147-5191.description:
Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible, if needed.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature you control, dealing 1 damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, creating a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-5485.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

334-2845-3556-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
334-2845-3556-3584.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Flicker at least once, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the first copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Any remaining copies of Flicker fizzle due to having no legal target.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Bloodwater Entity.
When Bloodwater Entity enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
Quintorius Kand and Thousand-Year Storm trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Flicker at least twice, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 3.
You may optionally target any permanent using the additional Flicker copies to blink them.

539-2653-3652-4300.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Nissa triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

2-198-1651-4947.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
2-198-1651-4947.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Thopter and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Thopter tokens and infinite colored mana, you may activate Sai's ability to draw infinite cards.

2022-3315-4067.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a Wedding Ring.
You have a way to draw a card.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
It is your turn.
2022-3315-4067.description:
Draw a card.
The opponent's Wedding Ring triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Mind's Eye triggers, holding priority, activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Mind's Eye trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1684-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
851-1684-2178-5231.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2178-2857-5256.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2857-5256.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness. You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2178-2857-5256.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

614-1518-1987-4792.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
614-1518-1987-4792.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Nucklavee, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
